items.text: IEA now sees full recovery in oil supplies from gulf producers deferred until 2027.
IEA sees total world oil supply 1.74 million bpd lower than demand in 2026 (prev. forecast 1.27 million bpd lower).
IEA: 2026 world oil demand to drop by 2.5 million bpd (prev. forecast 1.6 million bpd drop), citing impasse in US-Iran talks on resolving their conflict.
